notes.title: New Update: Heart Frames to Decorate Your Screen!
notes.content:
❤️ Hello, players!
We’re excited to share a lovely new update that brings more personality to your gameplay experience:
[hr][/hr]🌟 Main Feature
🖼️ Decorative Frame System

You can now enable animated heart frames on the sides of your screen!

Perfect for adding a cozy and personalized touch to your desktop while playing.

You can toggle the feature on or off in the game’s visual settings.
[hr][/hr]🔧 Additional Improvements
General performance optimizations.

Minor visual fixes to icons and menus.
[hr][/hr]💌 A Thank You Note
This update is another way for us to show how much we care about you!
Thank you for being part of our community. 💖

Got ideas for new frame themes? Let us know in the comments!
[hr][/hr]
🎮 With love,
The Forgate Games Team
